objectState: Discarded empty open peel lying flat on the floor
silhouette: Asymmetrical star-like spread with one central node and three splayed, curling elongated points

parts.name: Central Stem
parts.shape: Short, stubby, irregularly textured cylinder with a flat broken end
parts.connection: Joins directly to the top convergence point of all three skin flaps

parts.name: First Skin Flap
parts.shape: Long, curved, tapering wedge with edges rolled inward and a pointed tip
parts.connection: Radiates outward from the central stem base, resting flat on the ground

parts.name: Second Skin Flap
parts.shape: Long, curving wedge with a sharp spiral curl at the tapering end
parts.connection: Extends outward from the central stem at an obtuse angle to the first flap

parts.name: Third Skin Flap
parts.shape: Broad, slightly twisted tapering flap with a bowed profile
parts.connection: Extends from the remaining side of the central stem opposite the other flaps

recognitionCues: Contrasting pale cream inner surfaces against textured outer yellow skin
Curling tapering tips that twist toward the floor
Connected sturdy brown stem at the center junction
avoid: Featureless rounded blobs without structural ridges
